resources.string: Shows frames the GPU predicts between the frames of the game; a 30 fps game in a 60 fps stream counts as 30. Needs a GPU driver with frame extrapolation (Adreno).
Adds no wait; edges of fast objects can show small errors.
Only the frames of the stream are shown.
One predicted frame per game frame: 30 → 60 fps, 60 → 120 fps.
Two predicted frames per game frame: 30 → 90 fps.
Three predicted frames per game frame: 30 → 120 fps.
